title: Read File Record dual-subrequest parser depth
purpose: Reach nested record parsing with two complete subrequests so mutations can independently target aggregate byte count, reference type, file number, record number, and record length fields.
expected_behavior: The server should parse the complete Read File Record request and either return data for the requested records or issue a standard exception for unsupported or unavailable file access.
constraints_preserved: The message has a seven-byte Modbus/TCP MBAP header
MBAP length 0011 equals the unit identifier plus the sixteen-byte PDU
Read File Record byte count 0e equals two seven-byte subrequests
Each nested subrequest contains reference type 06 and three two-byte fields
No bytes follow the declared ADU
issue_safety_notes: The nested structure is an issue-guided parser analogue and is not the historical PoC. It preserves aggregate and nested length relationships and does not claim direct reachability of modbus_mapping_free.
